entities.summary: Magnus August Høiberg, known professionally as Cashmere Cat, is a Norwegian DJ and record producer. Often in tandem with Benny Blanco, he has been credited with production work for artists including Kanye West, BTS, Snoop Dogg, the Kid Laroi, Selena Gomez, Camila Cabello, Ariana Grande, Tory Lanez, Major Lazer, the Weeknd, Kali Uchis and Lil Uzi Vert. His debut studio album, 9 (2017), was released by blanco's Mad Love Records, an imprint of Interscope Records and peaked at number 14 on the VG-lista charts.
